summary: Wavelet coherence corroborates transfer entropy finding. NH-SH albedo coupling is frequency-dependent: strongest at interannual/ENSO periods (24-60 months, coh=0.985, 15.7% significant), annual-biennial (12-24 months, coh=0.954, 13.8% sig), and decadal (60-120 months, coh=0.996, 12.3% sig). Phase analysis: at interannual timescales, SH leads NH by ~4 months (consistent with A001 transfer entropy). At semi-annual timescales, NH leads SH by ~4 months. Second independent method confirming hemispheric teleconnections (H003).
